Name: Elliot's walking beautification mod1.6
Author: shenchengmi
Description:
The version with the hat had an unfixable bug so I deleted it, but its png file is still in my miscellaneous files if you need it. This mod replaces all of Elliot's in-game images, including seasonal walks, flower dances, and wedding appearances, including the sleeping look, and the small picture frame of the wedding. Please do not use it with other beautification mods for post-wedding portrait frames, it will not work after my tests.Of course, I am referring to the small picture frame beautification after marriage, it can not have other small picture frame beautification after marriage, they are repeated, will not be effective, marriage picture frame beautification.My contact information, please feedback any questions 2517608580@qq.com, or you can leave a comment to me
